blocks.text: Meet Our Uptown Houston Eye Doctor
blocks.html: Meet Our Uptown Houston Eye Doctor

Our eye doctors take the time to explain the results of [[a href="/eye-care-services/eye-exams/"]]your eye exam[[/a]], describe your options and listen to your eye care needs. Because maintaining good eye health is an ongoing partnership, we encourage you to ask questions and share your health information, which could be vital to monitoring, diagnosing, and treating potential vision problems.

Dr. Shawn Muldoon graduated from the University of Houston College of Optometry and now serves as an adjunct assistant professor at the Cornea and Contact Lens Service within the college. Due to his professorship within the university and his membership in the American Optometric Association, the Texas Optometric Association, and the Harris County Optometric Society, Dr. Muldoon is committed to remaining current on state of the art technology and procedures. Dr. Muldoon performs a number of different services, including eye examinations, optical frames dispensary, and dry eye/tear tests. He specializes in hard to fit contact lenses, ocular disease, laser vision correction, and primary care optometry. With a caring and friendly demeanor, Dr. Muldoon knows how to put patients at ease and make them feel well informed about their treatment. When he is not working, Dr. Muldoon enjoys cycling, soccer, and spending time with his family.

blocks.text: Briargrove Eye Center in Uptown Houston
blocks.html: Briargrove Eye Center in Uptown Houston

Briargrove Eye Center provides innovative eye care services to patients from in and around Uptown Houston. We offer comprehensive eye health assessments, ocular disease diagnosis and treatment, contact lens evaluation and fitting, and prescriptions.

The team at Briargrove Eye Center aims to provide the best possible solution for the patient's eye health and vision needs. By utilizing the latest technologies and evidence-based treatments, we can ensure that each patient maintains optimal eye health.
We welcome new patients and accept most major forms of insurance.
